snippet.title: City Car Driving 2.0. Teaser
snippet.description:
City Car Driving 2.0 is a driving simulator designed to help novice drivers master driving in a setting as close to reality as possible.
Early access is planned for Q1 2024.

City Car Drivng 2.0 on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2327720/

Our social media:
https://www.facebook.com/citycardriving/
https://vk.com/avtosimulator
